feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Head of French football to stand against Infantino in FIFA presidential election
articles.summary: The head of the French Football Federation has announced he will stand against Gianni Infantino in the FIFA presidential election.

articles.title: Man jailed for life for attempted murder of children that sparked Dublin riots
articles.summary: A man who attempted to murder three children - including stabbing one in the heart - as they waited outside their school in Dublin has been sentenced to life in prison.

articles.title: At least 17 people killed in two separate shootings in South Africa
articles.summary: At least 17 people have been killed in two separate shootings in South Africa, police said on Monday.

articles.title: Australian MP who lost her legs in alleged attack speaks on leaving hospital
articles.summary: Helen Haines, the Australian politician who lost both legs after an alleged attack, has said she is "full of gratitude" upon leaving hospital.

articles.title: William and Kate land in Mumbai for Earthshot Prize trip
articles.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales have arrived ‌in Mumbai for the Earthshot Prize awards, ‌marking the couple's first official trip overseas in nearly four years.

articles.title: Company caught up in Nvidia controversy launches internal investigation
articles.summary: A cloud computing company facing scrutiny over claims involving tech giant Nvidia has launched an internal investigation conducted by external lawyers.

articles.title: Hamas says senior commander killed in Israeli airstrike
articles.summary: A senior Hamas commander who helped plan and oversee the 7 October 2023 attack had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, according to the Palestinian militant group.

articles.title: US asked if Ukraine would give up parts of Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskyy says
articles.summary: The US has asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region if Kyiv were admitted to NATO, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold unprecedented meeting, White House says
articles.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia will hold an unprecedented meeting on the sidelines of a major economic summit, the White House has said.
